scripts.kill-port: node -e "require('dotenv').config({path:'.env.local'}); const port = process.env.PORT || 8080; console.log('Killing processes on port:', port); require('child_process').exec('lsof -ti:' + port + ' | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || true', (err) => { if(!err) console.log('Port cleared'); });"
scripts.dev: npm run kill-port && sleep 2 && nodemon src/app.ts
